route_reference.scope: Complete regular Paris metro station coverage, including branches and directional loops. Recording dates account for the 2024 line 11/14 extensions and the 2025 Villejuif opening; temporary closures and special services are not modeled.
route_reference.source_note: Official published line diagrams are linked per line. This bundled reference is maintained offline; live retrieval was unavailable in the development environment during this expansion.
